::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Feb 13th 1880  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS Devon Record Office, Exeter 53/10/9/2
:::

Dear Madam

The illustrations are most beautiful and I am very much struck with the expressiveness and good drawing of all the animals.  Unfortunately I have mislaid your first letter and cannot refer to it, so that I am not sure whether it was sent with a view to future publications, or to plans of publishing it.

I have no power to change my own [illustrators](organizations/other_167.qmd), but if you liked, I could send it to [Macmillans](organizations/other_111.qmd) and beg them to ask the same hand to illustrate some of my books

yours truly
C M Yonge
